watchme.trigger: each firing of the probe over the logs tree - it rides the device walk that already exists (ground_loop discovery enumerates class-space device folders) rather than a clock, and it needs no live host and no inference: the two populations it compares are files on disk and emit sites in the corpus.
watchme.enough: NOT satisfied by the corpus it was written against. Enough when the invariant has held across at least TWO device births that came AFTER this ticket landed - a device added later, logging on its first run with nobody having wired it - because a floor proved by the callers that already exist is a claim about nothing. Same enough-clause shape as a-standing-table-gains-its-constraint-through-the-one-door, deliberately borrowed.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the two counts it compares (components that emit, trails that exist) as measured values rather than as a pass word - so a later reader sees the coverage move rather than reading that it was fine.
watchme.nexus: the diagnostic nexus - what a mind needs on disk to diagnose a red without a second exploration; it teaches the same tree diagnostic_inspector's filters read, which is where 'what did we need and not have' accumulates.
watchme.consumer: CC at the moment of a red (through diagnostic_inspector, the prebuild-for-debugging surface), and Akien at the session-open banner when coverage regresses.
